contribution.position: Holding my earlier position, and answering product directly: product's claim that 'nobody else sees a problem' on reliability, so it should be treated as settled, is contradicted by artifact:incident-log, which shows a 1.8% 30-day error rate against a 0.3% SLO and two sev2 incidents — the error budget is already exhausted before this change lands. I also answer qa: artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) validates the change in isolation, but says nothing about the gateway's current degraded state, so it cannot settle the reliability axis. No new artifact has appeared since my last turn that measures production health post-change or shows error-budget recovery, so there is no basis to update; shipping now compounds an active SLO breach and obscures attribution of new errors.
